summary.text: Amy Neighbors is a Republican state representative who has represented Kentucky House of Representatives District 21 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She worked as an administrator with Metcalfe Health Care Center.

paragraphs.text: Amy Neighbors earned a B.S. in health care administration from Western Kentucky University in 1999.
Her career experience includes working as an administrator with Metcalfe Health Care Center, and she has served on the board of Life Skills Inc. and been affiliated with Leadership Kentucky.
She took office in the Kentucky House on January 1, 2023, as the successor to Bart Rowland.

For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the Health and Family Services, Licensing, Occupations, and Administrative Regulations, and Transportation committees and was vice chair of the House Local Government Committee.
The Republican primary for her seat on May 19, 2026, was canceled.
